plan.title: Live RFQ with Two Vendor Bids

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow.
Set the title used to identify the event.
Configure this as an RFQ-only event.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Set the requested delivery location.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for the two bids.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can quote.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's portal bid at 100 per unit.
Verify the first vendor bid was submitted.
Submit the second distinct vendor's portal bid at 90 per unit.
Verify the second vendor bid was submitted.
Confirm the buyer sees two direct vendor responses from both invited vendors.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to verify bid values and totals.
Confirm two real vendor columns are present.
Verify the first vendor's unit rate is 100.
Verify the first vendor's total is 1,000 for quantity 10.
Verify the second vendor's unit rate is 90.
Verify the second vendor's total is 900 for quantity 10.
